_comment: Template critic card. Copy to critics/<your_id>.json and fill in. Delete this _comment field and all _note fields when done.
thesis: One paragraph: the core evaluative logic of this theorist's framework. What does this theorist think makes an image work or fail? Use the theorist's own vocabulary.
_note_items_key: Choose ONE items key that fits the theory's structure. Use 'criteria' for bipolar axes (like Wölfflin), 'elements' for element-based frameworks (like Kandinsky), 'core_concepts' for concept-based frameworks (like Arnheim), 'principles' for principle-based frameworks (like Dow), or 'impulses' for drive-based frameworks (like Worringer). Register new keys in critic.py _ITEMS_KEYS and _ID_FIELDS.

criteria.label: Example Axis or Concept
criteria._note_bipolar: For bipolar axes, add pole_a and pole_b fields (see wolfflin.json). For unipolar concepts, omit them.
criteria.definition: What does this criterion assess, in the theorist's own terms? Quote directly where possible.
diagnostic_questions: What should the evaluator ask when looking at an image?
Include 3-5 questions that operationalize this criterion.

indicators._note: For bipolar: use pole_a/pole_b keys. For unipolar: use strong_<concept>/weak_<concept> keys. Delete this _note.
strong: Observable visual evidence that this criterion is strongly present
weak: Observable visual evidence that this criterion is weakly present or absent

feedback_directions._note: For bipolar: use toward_a/toward_b. For unipolar: use strengthen/reduce. Delete this _note.
strengthen: Concrete, actionable change to improve on this criterion
reduce: When and how to pull back on this criterion

common_misreadings: How this criterion is often misunderstood or misapplied
Include the theorist's own cautions where available

anti_goals: What this critic must NEVER do — e.g., impose subjective preference, conflate formal and representational quality

tensions.label: Name of an internal tension in the theory
tensions.description: How does this tension manifest? Theories are not seamless — document the friction points.

citations.claim: What claim from the card is being supported
citations.quote_or_paraphrase: Actual text or close paraphrase from the source

confidence_notes: Where is the theory hard to operationalize for machine vision?
What parts of the source text are ambiguous or contested?
